definitions.explanation: A densely populated urban area with modern infrastructure, entertainment, and commercial activity. Contrasts with {田舎|いなか} (countryside, rural area).

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}の{生活|せいかつ}は{便利|べんり}だけど{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: City life is convenient but busy.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}から{都会|とかい}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しました。
examples.english: I moved from the countryside to the city.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}では{車|くるま}より{電車|でんしゃ}が{便利|べんり}です。
examples.english: In the city, trains are more convenient than cars.

notes:
Refers to large urban centers characterized by tall buildings, public transportation, shops, and dense population. Often contrasted with {田舎|いなか} (countryside).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{都会|とかい}の{生活|せいかつ} (city life)
・{都会|とかい}に{住|す}む (live in the city)
・{都会|とかい}に{出|で}る (go to the city)
・{都会|とかい}で{働|はたら}く (work in the city)

SCOPE NOTE:
{都会|とかい} refers to any large city, while {都市|とし} is more formal/technical for 'city' and {首都|しゅと} specifically means 'capital city.'
